title: Canonical shifts and action units of the derived pullback tensor comparison
statement:
Let $f:(\mathscr X,R_X)\to(\mathscr Y,R_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by small sites, with sheaves of commutative rings and a ring map $f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the K-flat derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent], and the canonical derived pullback $L=Lf^*$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback]. Give $L$ its canonical comparisons obtained by shifting flat-term K-flat resolutions, and derived tensor the localized signed comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated, lem-weil-pbc-total-tensor-integer-shifts]. Let $\mu_{M,N}:L(M\otimes^L_{R_Y}N)\xrightarrow{\sim}LM\otimes^L_{R_X}LN$ be the canonical bifunctorial comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Put $\Phi(M,N)=L(M\otimes^LN)$ and $\Psi(M,N)=LM\otimes^LLN$. For $i=1,2$, let $s^i_{\Phi,n}$ and $s^i_{\Psi,n}$ be the composite shift comparisons on these functors when their $i$th input is shifted by $n\in\mathbf Z$ (using the comparison for $L$ also on the shifted tensor input in $\Psi$). Then, with $U_1=(M[n],N)$ and $U_2=(M,N[n])$,
$$s^i_{\Psi,n}\circ\mu_{U_i}=\mu_{M,N}[n]\circ s^i_{\Phi,n}.$$
There is a canonical isomorphism $u:L(R_Y[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}R_X[0]$, obtained by pulling back the degree-zero ring complex. Write $\rho$ and $\ell$ for the right and left tensor action unitors. For all $M,N$,
$$\rho_{LM}\circ(1\otimes u)\circ\mu_{M,R_Y[0]}=L(\rho_M),\qquad \ell_{LN}\circ(u\otimes1)\circ\mu_{R_Y[0],N}=L(\ell_N).$$
The shifts satisfy their zero and addition laws; the displayed equations are natural in both inputs, including all maps after localization. No flatness of the structural ring map, boundedness, direct image, adjunction, or projection mate is assumed in this statement.
